verified_rows.title: Public database / searchable directory
verified_rows.notes: Commit adds the crawlable 79-food database plus discovery links and eight tests. Live URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-07-29. Measurement due is the first 28-day search window.

verified_rows.title: D2. IndexNow
verified_rows.notes: Commit enforces one post-deploy IndexNow owner and adds ownership tests. GitHub Actions run 30390366792 completed successfully. Measurement due is the first seven-day crawl-latency check.

verified_rows.title: C5. Open dataset with an attribution-requiring license
verified_rows.notes: Commit publishes scoped CC BY 4.0 reuse terms, copy-ready attribution, Dataset and API license metadata, and machine-readable package/CITATION proof. Live URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-07-29. Traffic, downloads, citations, and referring domains remain unmeasured until the 28-day cohort closes.

verified_rows.title: Skimmable structure, jump links and table of contents
verified_rows.notes: Commit adds server-rendered accessible contents navigation to 86 long articles. The proof URL exposes seven jump links and every target ID resolved live on 2026-07-29. Search and engagement impact remain unmeasured until the 28-day cohort closes.

verified_rows.title: Printables and PDF downloads
verified_rows.notes: Commit ships a two-page printable grocery budget and meal planner, crawlable landing page, contextual tool links, private download telemetry, and visual PDF QA. The landing page and application/pdf download returned HTTP 200 after deploy run 30421858939. Organic sessions and downloads remain unmeasured until the 28-day cohort closes.

verified_rows.title: A11. E-E-A-T signals (author identity, credentials, sourcing, About/Contact)
verified_rows.notes: Commit publishes truthful editorial, sourcing, automation, correction, and medical-boundary standards; adds persistent discovery links and publishingPrinciples schema; and preserves the intentional contact-page noindex. The policy and article schema were verified live after deploy run 30421858939. Search and engagement impact remain unmeasured until the 28-day cohort closes.

verified_rows.title: A8. Index bloat pruning / content pruning
verified_rows.notes: The version-controlled pruning matrix audited all 267 unique articles against sitemap presence, observed search or link evidence, conservative thinness rules, intent similarity, and the protected recovery cohort. It found zero defensible MERGE, NOINDEX, or REMOVE candidates, so no destructive change was made. Re-run only with newer query, crawl, or duplication evidence.
